t: This is a memorial plaque to Joseph Innes, in the church of St Mary the Virgin in Lewisham. It was commissioned by William Innes, who lived from 1719 to 1795. William was a British merchant and politician, and he sat in the House of Commons from 1774 to 1775. The material I have doesn't say how he was connected to Joseph, so I'll leave that there. The plaque is what remains of the commission.
